name: Seru Logistics Depot
description: The Logistics Depot is Sanctus Seru’s central hub for decree-regulated freight and cargo distribution. Purity-screened loading bays, resonance-aligned freight rails, decree-regulated cargo stacks, and Praetorian logistics officers ensure doctrinal compliance across all shipments entering or leaving the city. Every crate, pallet, and shipment is monitored, scanned, and approved under the Tribunal’s doctrine.
